arg.name: contact_model
arg.description: friction | rollers. See r2_description/README.md. Both are holonomic; 'friction' is 5 links and stops reliably, 'rollers' is 37 links, more faithful, and coasts.

arg.name: use_ground_truth
arg.description: Emit the Gazebo odometry-publisher plugin used to score odometry and the EKF. Simulation only.

arg.name: publish_roller_states
arg.description: Publish the passive roller joints on /joint_states so the TF tree is complete. Adds 32 fast-changing frames to /tf.

arg.name: mecanum_mu_slip
arg.description: Friction ACROSS fdir1, the roller free-run direction. Lands in SDF mu2.

arg.name: mecanum_mu_grip
arg.description: Friction ALONG fdir1, the roller axle direction. Lands in SDF mu. Set equal to mecanum_mu_slip for an isotropic-wheel baseline.

arg.name: entity_name
arg.description: Gazebo model name. Must match the gz_topic_name prefix for ground-truth odometry in ros_gz_bridge.yaml.

let.name: robot_description
let.value: $(command 'xacro $(find-pkg-share r2_description)/urdf/r2.urdf.xacro use_sim:=true use_ros2_control:=true contact_model:=$(var contact_model) use_ground_truth:=$(var use_ground_truth) controllers_file:=$(var controllers_file) mecanum_mu_slip:=$(var mecanum_mu_slip) mecanum_mu_grip:=$(var mecanum_mu_grip) publish_roller_states:=$(var publish_roller_states) mecanum_roller_count:=$(var mecanum_roller_count) mecanum_roller_damping:=$(var mecanum_roller_damping) mecanum_roller_friction:=$(var mecanum_roller_friction)')

node.name: spawn_r2
node.args: -topic robot_description -name $(var entity_name) -allow_renaming true -x $(var x) -y $(var y) -z $(var z) -Y $(var yaw)
